2.8.2 preserves queued commands during subserver changes and intentional server transfers. The sender waits for the new world instead of dropping a command during its rate-limit pause. Commands accepted before login also survive the first world load. A kick or failed connection invalidates unsent commands, including the in-flight item, so they cannot replay in a later session. The client emits a dedicated transfer event so supervisors can preserve the current automation without treating a transfer as a kick or replaying initialization macros.
